utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring a chapter I liked and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll check with the others about the next book and meeting time, then I’ll let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, appreciate it — just keep me posted and I’ll go with the flow.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — just a quick update: the book club is now Thursday at the cafe. If you have a book idea, send it my way and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Thursday at the cafe works for me after pickup. I’ll send a book idea your way soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Faye — I’ll look out for your idea and add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks for reminding me. If you tell me the title, I’ll probably recognize it right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh good, thanks for keeping me straight — next Tuesday at 4:30 after school pickup, right? And it’s the mystery book, if I’m remembering correctly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, that sounds right — Tuesday at 4:30 after pickup. And yes, the mystery book; I’ll probably know it once I see the title.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re on "The Dutch House" this week, and everyone’s been bringing such different takes — it’s been really lovely.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, that’s the one — I’m looking forward to hearing everyone’s take. Same time still works for me, and I’ll bring a chapter I liked and some tea.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, Noah — tea and a favorite chapter are such a nice addition. I’m looking forward to hearing what you think with the group!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Same time still works for me—just bring a chapter you liked, and we’ll keep it easy over tea.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll bring a chapter I liked and stick to the usual time over tea.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — that works for me too. See you then over tea.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the book club details and next meeting time. Everyone’s welcome, and I’ll make sure you get the book and exact time too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn. Just send the details when you can, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send them over soon, and feel free to pass the word along to anyone else who wants to join!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what book are we on for the club?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We haven’t picked the next one yet. If you want, I can help choose something gentle.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great — I’m in the mood for something gentle too. What options are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still trying to find out the new novel and when they’re meeting—once I hear, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ve been hearing it’s still "The Marrow Thieves" and Thursday at 7 at the community center. If you hear any change, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — thanks, Nell! I’ll keep my ears open, and if anything changes, I’ll let everyone know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — do you want to pick a time and place, or should I check with everyone?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check with everyone and see what works best, then we can pick a time and place for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — that’d help a lot. Let me know what everyone says, and I’ll set the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s still on this week—let’s keep the usual time, and I’ll bring my notes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — I’ve got the usual time noted, and I’ll be ready to compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — I’ll see you then, and we can go over the notes together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please — if you can check the list, that would help me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll check the list and let you know what book we’re reading for book club this month.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll wait to hear which one it is.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re still on "The Marrow Thieves," and I’m keeping an eye on the community center details for Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Thursday at 7 at the community center — can you confirm that’s definitely set before I come?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not fully sure yet, but I’ll keep checking and let you know as soon as I can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet—I’m still deciding, but I should have one soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check with the others about the book and meeting time, then I’ll let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll look out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send me the title when you pick one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: We’re on "The Dutch House" this week, and I’ll make sure everyone has the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll look out for it and catch up on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it’s still the usual time and place? I just want to confirm before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m pretty sure it’s the usual time and place — I’m just a little fuzzy on the exact details. If you want, I can double-check with Hana.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please double-check with Hana — I just want to be sure before I go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d rather check who can make it first, then I can help pick a time and place that works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds good — I’ll keep track of who can make it and watch for any time or place updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — once you hear back, let me know and I’ll help settle the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — as far as I know, it’s still the usual time and place. If anything changed, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — that works for me. I’ll keep an eye out for any updates and be there at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything different.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — it’s the one we were going to read for book club this month. I can check the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be great. Could you check the list and send me the title so I can keep the book club notes updated?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — do you want to check the meeting time first, or should I help figure out the next book?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can do both — let’s check the meeting time first, and then I’ll share the next book as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what meeting time would you like me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know — I’d heard the mystery might be next, but I’m glad we’re still on "The Marrow Thieves" for Thursday at 7. I’ll keep following along for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll keep an ear out in case anything changes. If I hear an update, I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll plan on Thursday at 7 and wait for any new word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet — I’m still hoping to hear everyone’s picks first. If you’ve got any favorites, I’d love to hear them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I usually like something straightforward and well written. I’ll wait for the final picks, and then I’ll be there at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect — I’ll keep an ear out for the final picks and let you know as soon as we’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it — I’ll check what novel they picked and when they’re meeting, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess — keep me posted on the novel and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll find out the new novel and the meeting time, then let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7 works for me, thanks — and yes, please double-check the community center just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Seven sounds good to me — I’ll double-check the community center and let you know if I spot anything off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — that sounds great. I’ll plan on Thursday at 7 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — looking forward to it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll check with everyone first and then we can pick a time and place.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — let me know what everyone prefers, and I’ll happily go with the easiest time and place.
